data.spiritual_meaning: Rebecca expresses “To bind; to tie firmly”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rebecca total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
